name: Endless Chamber
promptTemplate: An infinity mirror room in {{grid_geometry}} geometry, saturated in {{palette}} hues receding into {{mirror_depth}} depths with {{camera_drift}} motion, amplified by {{glow_intensity}} bloom and audio strobe set to {{strobe_reaction}}.

mirror_depth.hint: Expand virtual reflections deeper into dark

glow_intensity.hint: Dial up radial halo bloom around bulbs

strobe_reaction.hint: Flash suspended bulbs to incoming audio kicks

listing.blurb: Suspended bulbs reflect infinitely across dark mirrored walls, casting pulsing waves of saturated colour deep into geometric corridors.
listing.prompt: An infinity mirror room: points of coloured light hanging in the dark are reflected endlessly between mirrored walls, receding into a vast grid of lights in every direction, the colours slowly changing in waves that travel out through the reflections. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
